definitions.calls: Salesforce Tasks where Type = Call, grouped by CreatedDate.
definitions.contacts: Salesforce call Tasks where CallDisposition starts with Contact, grouped by CreatedDate.
definitions.emails: Salesforce Tasks where Type/TaskSubtype = Email, grouped by CreatedDate.
definitions.discovery_set: Salesforce Events Type = 1-Discovery Call, grouped by CreatedDate; Task-subject fallback used only when no Events exist for a rep/month.
definitions.discovery_complete: Events Type = 1-Discovery Call with ActivityDate in month, excluding canceled/internal and requiring Completed/Held/Ran if status is populated.
definitions.initial_demos_complete: Events Type = 2-Initial DEMO with ActivityDate in month, excluding canceled/internal and requiring Completed/Held/Ran if status is populated.
definitions.opps_closed: Closed Won Opportunities by CloseDate for AE owners.
definitions.mrr_closed: Sum of Salesforce Opportunity Amount for those Closed Won Opportunities.
definitions.avg_cycle_days: Average days from Opportunity CreatedDate to CloseDate for Closed Won Opportunities.
